title: OOH-AHH Trace Event
description: Shared runtime event contract for visualization, timeline replay, validation overlays, and AI mentor explanations.

id.description: Stable unique id for this event within a trace session.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the event was recorded.

step.description: Monotonic zero-based order of this event in the trace timeline.

file_path.description: Project-relative source file path associated with the event.

line_number.description: One-based source line number when the event maps to a source line.

scope.description: Runtime or analysis scope where the event occurred.

id.description: Stable scope id for linking events.

name.description: Human-readable scope name, such as module or function name.

parent_id.description: Parent scope id when this scope is nested.

payload.description: Event-specific data. Keep this serializable and grounded in runtime or analysis facts.

name.description: Variable, function, loop, condition, or error name when applicable.

value.description: Observed value or return value when applicable.

previous_value.description: Previous value for update events when available.

expression.description: Source expression related to the event.

result.description: Evaluated result for conditions, calls, or expressions.

args.description: Function call positional arguments when available.

kwargs.description: Function call keyword arguments when available.

iteration.description: Zero-based loop iteration index when applicable.

error_type.description: Error or exception type for error events.

visual.description: Hints for graph and timeline presentation without requiring a specific renderer.

node_id.description: Preferred visualization node id associated with this event.

validation.description: Optional validation state attached to this event.
